tools.name: generate_social_post
tools.description: Write a social media post from scratch for a given platform and topic. Use this when you do not already have a draft — for example to produce several variations at once, or for platforms whose conventions you are unsure of. If you have already written the post yourself, prefer score_text and humaniz

tools.name: score_text
tools.description: Check how machine-written a piece of text reads, using an external AI detector. Returns a score from 0 to 65 where 0 reads as human and anything above 30 is likely to be flagged. Use this on text you have already written to find out whether it will pass before it is published — it is a measurement y

tools.name: humanize_text
tools.description: Rewrite text so it no longer reads as machine-written, using an external humanizing service. Use this on your own writing when score_text says it would be flagged. Brand names, domains and any lines listed in `preserve` are restored verbatim afterwards, because the humanizer rewrites whole sentences

tools.name: check_social_job
tools.description: Look up a social post generation job by id. Returns the finished posts once the job completes, or its current progress while it runs. Costs nothing.

tools.name: list_social_platforms
tools.description: List the platforms generate_social_post supports, with each one's default post length and emoji policy. Costs nothing and makes no network call.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_social_post, check_social_job, list_social_platforms · Public sink: generate_social_post, check_social_job, list_social_platforms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_social_post, check_social_job, list_social_platforms · Public sink: generate_social_post, check_social_job, list_social_platforms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
